rules: Profiles reference known modules and one known setup snapshot.
Profiles declare ordered entry decisions before dependent decisions are resolved.
Profiles list every required module dependency explicitly.
Profile module order resolves deterministically through dependency order.
Module dependencies and conflicts reference known modules.
Rule identifiers are unique across the catalog.
Managed root block identifiers are unique across the catalog.
Supporting guide identifiers are unique across the catalog.
Decision identifiers are stable public data.
Decision effects declare typed conditions, activated modules, dependent decisions, artifact inclusion or exclusion, template selections, and render bindings.
Decision effect targets reference catalog-owned modules, decisions, artifacts, templates, and template tokens.
A meaning change requires a new version or manifest migration.
Template paths are relative to assets/templates.
Templates may contain only declared decision tokens.
Root-block templates stay compact and point to supporting guides.
Skill paths are normalized relative paths.
Skill names are unique within a snapshot.
The snapshot digest is the sha256 of ordered normalized paths.
Coverage identifiers are unique and stable across the catalog.
Every versioned rule references only declared coverage identifiers.
Every rule declares coverage identifiers and portable guidance.
Every required skill has exactly one dispatch owner, and normalized declarations contain one or more globally unique stable triggers.
Every required rule is carried by a selected supporting guide whose template renders artifact.rules.
Setup-owned references resolve by managed identity and repository-owned references use safe repository-relative paths.
Every required rule belongs to a selected module.
Every required rule is reachable through a selected supporting-guide carrier.
External skills declare a GitHub owner/repository, immutable full commit object ID, safe source-relative directory, and lowercase complete-tree digest.
Repository-owned skills remain distinct from external immutable sources.
The snapshot digest covers canonical serialization of complete normalized skill records and any declared activation bundles.
Activation bundles have stable identities and ordered exact skill membership.
Activation contracts have globally unique stable trigger identities, one module owner, one exact bundle, and an optional capability condition.
Every selected Setup Snapshot persists exactly the active bundle identities and ordered memberships.
Bundle and trigger declarations use stable byte order and reference only selected snapshot skills before rendering.
Delegation aliases are bounded, normalized, unique category phrases.
Delegation aliases extend coverage identities without inspecting repository content during catalog loading.
Every rule contains one or more globally unique clauses with mandatory, prohibited, or stop-and-ask enforcement.
Every selected clause has exactly one supporting-guide carrier, and no two supporting guides in one module have the same effective clause list.
Every skill dispatch entry owns one or more globally unique stable triggers.
Repository-Owned Extensions use safe repository-relative paths, a scaffold template, a managed root pointer, and a declared decision.
Every profile explicitly selects a pinned formatter contract or declares that no formatter is selected.
A selected formatter declares safe fixture paths and one lowercase golden-corpus digest.
Every prior clause records its enforcement, carrier, and guidance digest.
Every source baseline declares one or more exact legacy Setup Manifest fingerprints.
Every prior clause has exactly one retained, moved, replaced, or rejected mapping with a reason.
Accepted mappings target a current clause with equal enforcement or a declared Repository-Owned Extension; rejected mappings have no target.
